maxItems.description:
---- the history (unpinned entries; pinned ones are never dropped) ---------------------------------
At most this many entries; the oldest go first. Default 1000; a whole number, 0 and up.

Takes a whole number, 0 and up. Default: 1000.

maxAgeDays.description:
An entry not copied again for this many days is dropped. Default 30; a whole number, 0 and up.

Takes a number, 0 and up. Default: 30.

maxImageMB.description:
An image larger than this (MB) is not recorded at all. Default 25; a whole number, 0 and up.
(Any other non-text copy has a fixed cap of 8 MB.)

Takes a number, 0 and up. Default: 25.

maxTotalMB.description:
The bytes of all entries together stay under this (MB); the oldest go first. Default 500; a whole number, 0 and up.

Takes a number, 0 and up. Default: 500.

thumbPx.description:
An image's thumbnail fits in a square of this many px (never enlarged). Default 320; a whole number, 1 and up.

Takes a whole number, 1 and up. Default: 320.

thumbsMax.description:
Only the newest this many images keep a thumbnail (pinned ones always do); 0 = no thumbnails. Default 48; 0 and up.

Takes a whole number, 0 and up. Default: 48.

textIndexKB.description:
Text longer than this (KB) is kept in the index cut to this length, with the full text in a file beside it.
Default 16; a whole number, 1 and up.

Takes a number, 1 and up. Default: 16.

ttlS.description:
Seconds a sealed copy stays available. Default 120; a number above 0.

Takes a number, 1 and up. Default: 120.

dropOnLock.description:
Drop every sealed copy when the screen locks. Default true.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

dropOnSourceClear.description:
Drop every sealed copy when the app it came from clears the clipboard. Default true.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

heuristic.description:
Seal single-line text that looks like a credential (a known token shape, a password-shaped string, a passphrase).
false: only "sealApps" and an app's own sensitive hint seal a copy. Default true.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

threshold.description:
The password shape needs at least 4 x threshold + 0.5 bits of entropy per character (2.5 at 0.5); higher seals
fewer strings. Default 0.5; a number, 0 and up (not clamped; about 1.5 asks for 6.5 bits, the most a
string of printable ASCII reaches).

Takes a number, 0 and up. Default: 0.5.

secrets.description: ---- secrets (a sealed copy is held in the shell's memory only, never written to disk) ---------------

ignoreApps.description:
Window classes whose copies are not recorded at all (matched whole, case-insensitive; "sealApps" below keeps them for a while). Default none.

Takes a list of texts. Default: [].

sealApps.description:
Window classes whose copies are always sealed (matched whole, case-insensitive). Default the two below.

Takes a list of texts. Default: ["Proton Pass","proton-pass"].

default.description: Takes a text like CTRL SHIFT,V. Default: "CTRL,V".

classes.description:
Per window class (exact, then case-insensitive). Classes listed here are added to the defaults below, which stay.

Default: {"kitty":"CTRL SHIFT,V","foot":"CTRL SHIFT,V","Alacritty":"CTRL SHIFT,V","org.wezfurlong.wezterm":"CTRL SHIFT,V","com.mitchellh.ghostty":"CTRL SHIFT,V"}.

pasteKeys.description:
---- pasting -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The key the paste sends to the window the popup was opened over, as Hyprland writes a shortcut:
"MODS,KEY" (modifiers space-separated: CTRL, SHIFT, ALT, SUPER). Default "CTRL,V".

reofferOnClose.description:
When the app that owned the clipboard closes and the clipboard empties, put that entry back. Default true.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

openOverFullscreen.description:
The popup's shortcut (and the picker's) also opens it while the active window is fullscreen. Default true; false: it does nothing then.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

pasteDelayMs.description:
Milliseconds between the popup letting go of the keyboard and the paste key. Default 120; 0 and up.

Takes a whole number, 0 and up. Default: 120.

enter.description:
What Enter (and a double click on the shelf) does with the entry: "paste" | "copy".

Takes "paste" or "copy". Default: "paste".

joiner.description:
What stands between several entries pasted as one. Default a line break.

Takes a text. Default: "\n".

copyOnClose.description:
Closing the popup by Escape copies the entry you chose (moved to, or clicked); one the popup opened on is not chosen. Default true.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

restoreAtStart.description:
At the shell's start, when the clipboard is empty, the newest entry is put back on it. Default true.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

pinnedFirst.description:
---- the list ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Pinned entries stand first. false: every entry where its time puts it. Default true.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

openOn.description:
The filter it opens on: "all" | "text" | "image" | "link" | "pinned".

Takes "all", "text", "image", "link" or "pinned". Default: "all".

undoSec.description:
How long a deletion can be undone, seconds. Default 8; 1 .. 120.

Takes a number 1 .. 120. Default: 8.
